mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (product_name, product_type, model, manufacturer, manu_date) VALUES (#{productName}, #{productType}, #{model}, #{manufacturer}, #{manuDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET product_name = #{productName}, product_type = #{productType}, model = #{model}, manufacturer = #{manufacturer}, manu_date = #{manuDate} WHERE product_id = #{productId}
